root_cause: Post-execution PR verification accepted only OPEN. PR #17 was merged before the worker verified the agent result, so the correct repository, task branch and main base were rejected solely because GitHub returned MERGED. The worker replaced the successful implementation result with a blocked result and omitted its PR link.
fix_summary: Accept GitHub-verified OPEN or MERGED PRs with the existing repository URL, exact branch and main-base checks. Convert an already-merged result to an internal done outcome, publish Done to the original task, retain its evidence and route its notification to project updates. CLOSED and identity mismatches remain rejected. The affected live task and original notification were reconciled against merged PR #17 under the worker lock without rerunning implementation.
